newsitem.title: USA: General Motors says 22,739 employees idled.
newsitem.headline: General Motors says 22,739 employees idled.

text.p: General Motors Corp said on Monday that 22,739 GM North American employees were idled as of 1600 EST as a result of a strike by the Canadian Auto Workers Union that ended last week.
This is an increase from the 21,488 employees GM reported as idled earlier in the day.
Today's employee number does not include GM's Delphi operations, where a majority of employees have returned to work. As of today, Delphi will no longer issue daily reports.
Today, Buick City, Flint, Mich., was idled affecting 3,200 employees and a Detroit/Hamtramck assembly facility brought back 1,100 for first shift operations only.
GM repeated that it would not speculate on when workers in the U.S. will return to their operations. In addition, it would not speculate on additional facilities that could be affected.
GM said its next update would be at 11000 EST, Tuesday, October 29, 1996.
The membership of the CAW ratified a tentative labor contract last Tuesday and is returning to work in stages.
